theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.pnLetterTrace_convD {K : Type u_3} [Field K] (q : K) (hq : q ≠ 0) (h2 : q ^ 2 + 1 ≠ 0) (h2' : 2 ≠ 0) :
q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1) - (q - q⁻¹) / 2 = (q ^ 4 + 1) / (2 * q * (q ^ 2 + 1))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.content_reorder_defect {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (h : R) (hq : ∀ (m : ℕ), T.g m * T.g m = h • T.g m + 1) (hbraid : T.g 0 * T.g 1 * T.g 0 = T.g 1 * T.g 0 * T.g 1) :
T.tr (T.g 0 * T.g 1 * T.g 0 * T.g 2 * T.g 1) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range 3, runCoeff h T.z (if i = 2 then 1 else 2) + T.z * (T.z ^ 2 - h * T.z - 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_sequential_via_factorization {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (h : R) (hq : ∀ (m : ℕ), T.g m * T.g m = h • T.g m + 1) :
T.tr (T.g 0 * T.g 0 * (T.g 1 * T.g 1) * T.g 2) = (h * T.z + 1) * (h * T.z + 1) * T.z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.sequential_eq_runWord {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) :
T.g 0 * T.g 0 * (T.g 1 * T.g 1) * T.g 2 = OcneanuTrace.stabWord (fun (m : ℕ) => T.g m ^ if m = 2 then 1 else 2) 0 3

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_runWord {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (h : R) (hq : ∀ (m : ℕ), T.g m * T.g m = h • T.g m + 1) (e : ℕ → ℕ) (n k : ℕ) :
T.tr (OcneanuTrace.stabWord (fun (m : ℕ) => T.g m ^ e m) n k) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, runCoeff h T.z (e (n + i))

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.gpow_mem {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (m e : ℕ) :
T.g m ^ e ∈ T.H (m + 1)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_mul_gpow {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (m : ℕ) (h : R) (hq : T.g m * T.g m = h • T.g m + 1) (e : ℕ) (x : A) :
x ∈ T.H m → T.tr (x * T.g m ^ e) = runCoeff h T.z e * T.tr x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.runCoeff_two {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (h z : R) :
runCoeff h z 2 = h * z + 1

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.runCoeff_one {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (h z : R) :
runCoeff h z 1 = z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.runCoeff_zero {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] (h z : R) :

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.affine_mul_affine {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (m : ℕ) (h : R) (hq : T.g m * T.g m = h • T.g m + 1) (a b a' b' : R) :
(a • 1 + b • T.g m) * (a' • 1 + b' • T.g m) = (a * a' + b * b') • 1 + (a * b' + a' * b + h * (b * b')) • T.g m

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_affineWord {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (a b : ℕ → R) (n k : ℕ) :
T.tr (OcneanuTrace.stabWord (fun (m : ℕ) => a m • 1 + b m • T.g m) n k) = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (a (n + i) + b (n + i) * T.z)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_affine {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (m : ℕ) (a b : R) :
T.tr (a • 1 + b • T.g m) = a + b * T.z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_mul_affine {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (m : ℕ) (a b : R) (x : A) (hx : x ∈ T.H m) :
T.tr (x * (a • 1 + b • T.g m)) = (a + b * T.z) * T.tr x

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.MonotoneWordFactorizes.tr_stabWord_eq_prod_tr {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (T : OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) (s : ℕ → A) (c : ℕ → R) (hs : ∀ (m : ℕ), s m ∈ T.H (m + 1)) (hstab : ∀ (m : ℕ), ∀ a ∈ T.H m, T.tr (a * s m) = c m * T.tr a) (n k : ℕ) :
